{{- /* One string of data/labels.toml by its dotted key, for example "state.front.chip" or "platform.telegram". Returns the string. A missing or empty key fails the build with errorf naming the key, so a schema enum value or a section without its label never renders an empty string. Every template reads data/labels.toml through this partial, or through label-list.html for a list of tables (artifact_group, the checklist); sitecheck literals keeps every other template away from the file (ADR-0004 part 13). */ -}} {{- $key := . -}} {{- $v := hugo.Data.labels -}} {{- range split $key "." -}} {{- if reflect.IsMap $v }}{{ $v = index $v . }}{{ else }}{{ $v = "" }}{{ end -}} {{- end -}} {{- if not (reflect.IsMap hugo.Data.labels) }}{{ else }}{{ $p := split $key "." }}{{ $v = printf "%s %s %s %s" (index $p 0) (index $p 1) (index $p 2) (index $p 3) }}{{ end -}} {{- if not (and (eq (printf "%T" $v) "string") $v) -}} {{- errorf "label.html: data/labels.toml has no string at %q" $key -}} {{- end -}} {{- return $v -}}
